Container.Name: telegram-archive
Container.Overview: Automated Telegram backup service that periodically archives messages and media from your chats, groups, and channels. Uses Telethon for scheduled exports with optional real-time message listening. Supports SQLite or PostgreSQL, media deduplication, and configurable retention. [br][br] This is the backup container. For browsing archived messages, install the [b]Telegram Archive Viewer[/b] container separately. [br][br] [b]Requires Telegram API credentials[/b] from https://my.telegram.org [br][br] [b]Log in to Telegram before the first start.[/b] Telegram sends a code that has to be typed back, and this container has no terminal attached, so run the image once by hand from the Unraid terminal with the same paths and credentials: [br] docker run -it --rm -v /mnt/user/appdata/telegram-archive/session:/data/session -v /mnt/user/appdata/telegram-archive/backups:/data/backups -e TELEGRAM_API_ID=... -e TELEGRAM_API_HASH=... -e TELEGRAM_PHONE=+15550100000 drumsergio/telegram-archive:latest python -m telegram_archive auth [br][br] The image runs as UID 1000, and Docker creates a missing folder as root, so create the two folders and chown them to 1000:1000 first. Full walkthrough: https://geiserx.github.io/Telegram-Archive/getting-started/unraid/ [br][br] More info: https://github.com/GeiserX/Telegram-Archive
